title: generator-export — export a generated tree as real page.js files

set.request: The generator roadmap's endgame: export a generated tree as real page.js files. An Export control writes the current tree to disk as a real module directory - one dir per page, each with a minimal page.js, the root importable and browsable like any hand-written module. Target /imagine/generated/<name>/, dev-only via rpc:write, never overwrite, wire the /imagine/generated/ index seam. Prove the round trip.
set.now: verified - round trip green, refusal + no-socket proven; writing docs
steps: read the generator, the write path, the page contract
decide the exported module shape (one page.js per word)
hand-write the /imagine/generated/ index seam and wire /imagine/page.js
round-trip verify on the private port (structure counts + names)

links.label: the generator, with the Export control
readme — what a generated directory is

set.outcome:
**The generator can now write its tree out as real `page.js` files.** One click under the spec box turns the tree you are looking at into a directory of ordinary modules under [`/imagine/generated/<name>/`](/imagine/generated/) — one dir per page, real imports from `/app.js`, `children:` naming the subdirs, the width words the spec gave them. Nothing in there imports anything from the generator.

![the exported tree, browsing as Miller columns](exported-tree.png)

**Round trip green.** Seed 7 (all five words, 14 pages) exported to 15 files, then loaded as real modules and walked: the `{name, title, width}` tree of the generator's live render and of the loaded modules are string-identical. Zero console errors; no horizontal body scroll at 400 / 1920 / 3440.

**The five words write what the readme already said they would** — `wall` is `previews()`, `list` is *nothing at all* (core's column already draws children as rows, which is what an inbox is), `prose` is a line of `md()`, `tabs`/`vtabs` are `ext/tabs`.

**Dev only, both states proven.** Off localhost the button is disabled with one grey line; forced past it, every rpc is raced against a clock and answers a line, never an exception. Proving that needed `http://127.0.0.2` — a LAN ip renders nothing at all, because `crypto.randomUUID()` needs a secure context and `ext/Panel` dies without it.

**Never overwrites.** A second export under a name that exists is refused quietly; deleting the directory is how you say you meant it.

**SEEDED GENERATOR LAW held** — sha256 of `gen(seed)` on seeds 1 / 7 / 42 / 99 / 1234 / 999999 identical before and after, MODEL v3. `gen.js`, `rules.js`, `spec.js`, `tree.js` never opened for writing: the export is a READ of the live tree.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![the control](control.png) | ![refused](refused.png) |
| the control, after a clean export | the same name, refused |

**Left on purpose:** a delete control (that is `rm` on files somebody may have edited), any target other than `/imagine/generated/`, reading files back into a spec, exporting the dressing (`size`/`gap`/`look` are not the tree), and `flow=` — it swaps the generator's own nav between grid and flex, and `previews()` is one grid.
